technique_name: Storytell and explain a physics phenomenon
description: When it comes to physics, nothing is quite as fascinating as inertia. Inertia is the tendency for an object to resist being pushed or pulled and to continue doing whatever it was doing before. For example, if you're pushing a car, you need to use a lot of force in order to get it moving. But once the car is moving, it takes much less force to keep it in motion.
